# Divit Mittal

> Divit Mittal's personal portfolio site, including a RAG-powered digital avatar for questions about Divit's background, projects, and skills.

## Site

- [Home](https://divit.qezta.com/): Portfolio and digital avatar entry point.
- [Qezta](https://qezta.com/): Landing site connected to this portfolio.
- [Sitemap](https://divit.qezta.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlable site URLs.
- [Robots](https://divit.qezta.com/robots.txt): Crawler access policy.
